Nora: Postmortem follow-up: recurring KV frag/OOM on prod-green. Need owners for profiling, short-term throttle, and canary rollback plan.
Eli: I can take profiling and heatmaps. Will collect heap + alloc stacks and produce a short archetype note. ETA 36h.
Chen: I'll own GC/eviction experiments and a minimal config diff for a soft-residency cap + staggered eviction windows. 72h to PR + canary plan.
Eli: Commands I used during incident: `./runtime profile --heap /tmp/heap.pb` and `tools/shard_heatmap --shards=green-* --out=heat.json`. Upload to s3://incidents/pm-3930012345/.
Nora: Action owners: Eli = artifacts + report; Chen = GC/config PR + canary; Nora = coordinate ops + schedule check-ins. Make all changes reversible and add a rollback flag.
Chen: Short-term mitigation idea: soft-limit alpha pool at 85% residency and overflow to low-residency pool. Needs routing-flag and infra approval.
ops-bot: ACL request: write to s3://incidents/pm-3930012345 granted to eli. Remaining: chen.
Eli: Artifact upload done: s3://incidents/pm-3930012345/profiles_v1.tar.gz (pprof + heatmaps).
Chen: Pushed draft PR with small config diffs and rollback flag: https://git.internal/runtime/-/merge_requests/1401. Canary window proposed: 2 hours with on-call watch.
Nora: CI smoke test owner? We need a harness that asserts residency growth < 1.2x baseline under concurrent small-context load.
Eli: I'll sketch a harness and add to CI.
Nora: Timeline recap: Eli 36h, Chen 72h, CI+runbook 5d. Weekly check-in Fri 11am. Post updates here.
notes: Concise Slack thread assigning owners and timelines for KV-residency fragmentation/OOM follow-ups: profiling, GC tuning, soft limits, canary, CI smoke tests, and ACLs.
